subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Clear communication can reduce anger.”?
options: Things often feel more valuable when people understand what it costs to fix them.
It depends on gravity, light, water, air, and care-things people on Earth often take for granted.
Climate adaptation often begins with knowing who needs help and where help exists.
People often react not only to delay, but to not knowing why delay is happening.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Things often feel more valuable when people understand what it costs to fix them.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It depends on gravity, light, water, air, and care-things people on Earth often take for granted.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Climate adaptation often begins with knowing who needs help and where help exists.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Clear communication can reduce anger. People often react not only to delay, but to not knowing why delay is happening.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
